title: 第13章 洞府开启第14章 争夺宝物
content_zh:
楚峰沉默了。
他不知道这苏紫英和庞烈究竟是什么关系。
但是，他却不会出卖庞烈。
“怎么？说出这件事很难吗？莫非你是杀人越货得来的？”
苏紫英的语气异常冷漠。
楚峰能够感受到，一旦自己回答不对，恐怕对方会立刻出手，逼自己说出口。
“是一位前辈传给我的，他被困在一个地方，我侥幸的救了他，他便以此秘法作为报答！”
楚峰并未说谎。
他的确是救了庞烈。
“那人叫什么名字？你是在何处救的他？何时救的他？”
苏紫英语气有些急促了起来。
“嗯？看这模样，她似乎和庞烈的关系不一般啊！
！”
楚峰心思涌动，察觉到了苏紫英语气之中的异样。
随后，他故作思考样，沉默了少许之后，开口回道。
“那位前辈只告诉我他姓庞，所以我并不知道他的真名。
至于是何处，我自己也不太清楚，那里昏暗无比，我也是碰巧进入那里的。
至于什么时候，大概是三……”
正当楚峰说到这里的时候，整个林子突然开始震动了起来。
随后，他身后不远处一道光门直冲云霄。

“三年么？”
苏紫英轻声说道。
楚峰并未继续说下去。
苏紫英如此误会，倒是不会给庞烈造成麻烦。
“好了，这胎化易形之术，你且好好修炼，不要辜负了庞，那位前辈的好意。
这一次洞府开启，你就跟着我们浩阳宗一起进去吧。
不过，以你的修为，也只能在最外围寻找一些小机缘。
至于洞府核心之地，你就不要去参与了。
切不可因为一时的贪念，而枉送了性命。
还有…”
说到这里，苏紫英拿出一枚令牌，丢给了楚峰。
“凭借这一枚令牌，你可以进入我浩阳宗当一名外门弟子，就当是你救，救诗瑶的报答吧！”
说完，不待楚峰反应，便抓着他的衣领离开了密林。
下一刻，两人便回到了青铜巨门前。
而楚峰手里还依旧拿着那一枚宗门弟子令牌。
这一幕，被在场的所有人都看在了眼里。
“这苏锋真是好运气，竟然获得了浩阳宗的特招名额，还是苏长老给的。”
content_en:
Chu Feng was silent.
He didn't know what the relationship between Su Ziying and Pang Lie was.
However, he will not betray Pang Lie.
"What? Is it difficult to tell this? Could it be that you got it by killing people and selling goods?"
Su Ziying's tone was unusually cold.
Chu Feng could feel that if he answered incorrectly, the other party would probably take action immediately and force him to say it.
"It was passed on to me by a senior. He was trapped in a place. I was lucky enough to save him, and he repaid me with this secret technique!"
Chu Feng did not lie.
He indeed saved Pang Lie.
"What's that man's name? Where did you rescue him? When did you rescue him?"
Su Ziying became a little angry.
"Huh? Looking at it like this, she seems to have an unusual relationship with Pang Lie!
! "
Chu Feng's thoughts surged and he noticed something strange in Su Ziying's aura.
Then, he pretended to think, and after a short silence, he replied.
“The senior only told me his surname was Pang, so I didn’t know his real name.
As for where it was, I didn't know very well. It was extremely dark and I happened to enter there.
As for when, it’s probably three…”
Just when Chu Feng said this, the entire forest suddenly began to shake.
Then, not far behind him, a door of light shot straight into the sky.
"Three years?"
Su Ziying said softly.
Chu Feng did not continue.
Su Ziying's misunderstanding will not cause trouble to Pang Lie.
"Okay, you should practice this art of fetal transformation well, and don't let down the good intentions of that senior Pang.
This time the cave is opened, you can go in with our Haoyang Sect.
However, with your cultivation level, you can only find some small opportunities on the outermost edges.
As for the core of the cave, you don’t want to participate.
Don't waste your life because of temporary greed.
And…”
Having said this, Su Ziying took out a token and threw it to Chu Feng.
"With this token, you can enter our Haoyang Sect and become an outer disciple. Just think of it as a reward for saving Shi Yao!"
After saying that, without waiting for Chu Feng's reaction, he grabbed his collar and left the dense forest.
The next moment, the two of them returned to the giant bronze door.
But Chu Feng still held the sect disciple token in his hand.
This scene was witnessed by everyone present.
"Su Feng is really lucky. He actually got the special recruitment quota of Haoyang Sect, and it was given by Elder Su."
